title: anchusa italica f. macrophylla
intro: Anchusa italica f. macrophylla, commonly known as Italian bugloss or large-leaved bugloss, is a perennial plant belonging to the borage family (Boraginaceae). It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and fighting against infections, due to its antibacterial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to act as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant, making it useful in treating respiratory issues and wounds. The bioactive constituents of Anchusa italica f. macrophylla include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
